articles.title: Meta's WhatsApp head to step down, will be replaced by Indian fintech founder Kunal Shah
articles.description: Will Cathcart will step down as the head of WhatsApp and move into another role at the company. Kunal Shah will take over.

articles.title: Can anyone join Musk in the trillionaire club? Zuckerberg has best shot, according to prediction markets
articles.description: The Meta CEO is seen as next to join the Tesla and SpaceX CEO. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is seen as the second-most-likely.

articles.title: WhatsApp to be led by Indian start-up founder as Will Cathcart steps back
articles.description: WhatsApp's leadership shake-up comes as Meta looks to strengthen its app's already booming presence in India.
